acceptance_criteria.statement: A standalone x64 executable opens an ordinary native Windows window; initial status explicitly shows zero pen events/samples and unknown pressure.
WM_POINTER pen events use GetPointerPenInfo and preserve raw input kind, pointer ID, pressure availability and normalized pressure; absent pressure is explicitly unavailable, never fabricated.
Pen contact draws strokes; hover, mouse and touch cannot create ink. Mouse events are counted diagnostically so missing PT_PEN is visible.
Distinct pointers cannot append into another active stroke; release/cancel/focus loss ends capture. Each new contact has a new stroke identity.
Nonfinite coordinates or invalid pressure are rejected; capacity 8000 stops immediately with visible limit; Clear resets input and ink.
Window close exits; failure to create/register window produces a visible actionable error; no filesystem or network side effects except explicit build/test evidence.
Independent QA owns tests and classifies Windows compile/UI/physical pen as separate outcomes; exact source/build hashes bind results.

ux_contract.status: Always visible above canvas: pen events, mouse events, retained samples, pressure or unavailable, input state

data_contract.history: stroke identity only; no undo claim
data_contract.unknown_pressure: retained explicitly as unavailable; constant diagnostic width disclosed

security: SDK only, no network/credentials/document IO. Default-user launch. App Control failures stop; no bypass.
rollback: Delete new build output or revert isolated branch; preserve all prior source and state.
